name: production-failure-investigator
description: Local-first AI production incident investigation tool (NOT a monitoring dashboard)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace=@pfi/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@pfi/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@pfi/shared && npm run build --workspace=@pfi/server && npm run build --workspace=@pfi/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@pfi/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pfi/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pfi/web
